raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.10.2"

package:
  name: fps-terminals
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/f/fps-terminals/fps_terminals-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: d4e78a8352b24bd8415c280486933cee62c216a8eab57748b880df875a1864b6

build:
  number: 1
  script:
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check

requirements:
  build:
    - python
    - uv-build >=0.11.32,<0.12
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - uv-build >=0.11.32,<0.12
  run:
    - python
    - anyio
    - fastapi-core
    - fps
    - jupyverse-api >=0.15.0,<0.16.0
    - jupyverse-auth >=0.2.0,<0.3.0
    - jupyverse-terminals >=0.1.0,<0.2.0
    - if: win
      then:
        - pywinpty
    - structlog

tests:
  - python:
      imports: fps_terminals
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: COPYING.md
  homepage: https://github.com/jupyter-server/jupyverse/tree/main/plugins/terminals
  summary: An FPS plugin for the terminals API

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - davidbrochart
